note: Provenance for rust-bootstrap 1.100.1. Component URLs point at the release-neutral dist root because the dated dist directory for this patch release was not verifiable at edit time; validation must confirm each URL resolves on the 1.100.1 channel and regenerate sha256sums from the fetched bytes. Per-component and manifest hashes from the 1.100.0 snapshot were removed instead of being carried over, and are not restated here because they do not cover the 1.100.1 artifacts. The signed channel manifest recorded above (verified against the pinned PGP key in keys/pgp/) remains the upstream integrity authority.
